description: Limite du Domaine Public Fluvial - Département de Tarn-et-Garonne is a dataset listed in Tarn et Garonne Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Direction Départementale des Territoires de Tarn-et-Garonne. Limite approximative entre le Domaine Public Fluvial et les parcelles privés. La limite réglementaire du Domaine Public Fluvial est défini par la règle dite du "Plenissimum flumen", limite des plus hautes eaux avant débordement. Coverage: Tarn-et-Garonne. The portal files it under Données territoriales, Environnement. Its keywords are tarn et garonne, domaine fluvial. The portal shows 2 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-07-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-82amenagement-fr-portal.
